_comment: Read by audit.py from the default branch only. Changing this file is a 7a change (operator merges), and the front door pins its blob (design R6). Design: acardote/personal-assistant-ultra docs/design/merge-model.md section 4; child issue acardote/personal-assistant-ultra#581. trusted_record_authors must equal .github/verdict/config.json's (a test checks it). baseline_sha: commits up to and including it predate the audit (pre-pilot, operator-made) and are not audited. accepted_previous_code: after a 7a change to audit.yml, audit.py or this file, list the PREVIOUS code digest here (PAU `fleet_audit_check.py pins` prints it as audit_code_digest) so the first run of the new code accepts the old code's state; otherwise that run fails closed until a rebaseline=continue dispatch.
